content: Ryan is back and we spent some time today sketching out the work we figure needs to get done in order for us to announce a web preview publicly. Here's some nasty graphviz to start us off while Ryan finishes making a Google doc:
(Also, we figured we should make a Zulip channel for the web preview generally so that others can be added and participate without needing new DM groups.)
For my part, I'm almost done adding getter and setter support to wasm-tools. The PR ended up way bigger than expected, as it always does.

all we gotta do now is keep track of all the deps over time so we can get a "true graph" and then we can diff the graphs and then ...

anyway nice! Is the gdoc world-readable or intended to be just a few addresses?
well, lemme rephrase, it's not world-readable, so should we send you addresses to add?
I relaxed it to public can comment, I can add anyone as an editor if they'd like.
Unfortunately I'm not smart enough for JIRA/trello, so Google docs it is for now...
I can barely manage a calendar myself
I think a Trello could be ok if/when we're at a point when we want to communicate some kind of public roadmap, but I actually like that Google docs allow for freeform commenting and structure
so for now I think it's fine, it can live in my pinned tabs for a couple months
FYI, we just decided to make this channel public because why not - we're already discussing all this in the meeting every week, and there are lots of people we'll probably need to add / ping.
